title: [Tech] Especialista em Desenvolvimento Full Stack - .Net
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você terá a oportunidade de impactar diretamente o setor RH. Buscamos um(a) Especialista Full Stack com foco em IA com forte visão de arquitetura e inovação, que será responsável pela gestão e operação de um Consultor digital, atuando como ponto focal para iniciativas de experimentação e aplicação de tecnologias de IA. Este profissional terá como missão fomentar a cultura de IA, promover o uso ético e estratégico da IA, e apoiar colaboradores e equipes na exploração de soluções inteligentes que agreguem valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Propor soluções conceituais e orientar a implementação de projetos de IA;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural e/ou Visão Computacional;
  • Familiaridade com as capacidades e limitações da IA Generativa (ex: LLMs);
  • Integração de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) com APIs e sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e suas aplicações em negócios;
  • Integrar soluções de IA a sistemas corporativos de ERP, atuando no desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Implementar e validar POCs (provas de conceito) de novas tecnologias e soluções;
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Visão sistêmica: entender impactos das decisões técnicas no ecossistema como um todo;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas;
  • Orientar e atuar junto ao time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio e arquitetura, por meio de pesquisas e trocas de conhecimento com áreas parceiras.Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Boa lógica de programação e princípios SOLID;
  • Conhecimento em Back-end (c#, .Net);
  • Conhecimento em Front-end (Angular/TypeScript);
  • Graduação completa em Computação, Engenharia, Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio de IA/ML (NLP, LLMs, classificação e extração de entidades) e capacidade analítica para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de IA;
  • Engenharia de prompts, MCP, RAG, pipelines, modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados;
  • Experiência com projetos de IA Generativa;
  • Banco de Dados: SQL e NoSQL;
  • Controle de Versão: Git e ferramentas associadas (Repos, GitHub, GitLab);
  • APIs e configuração e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Noções de segurança da informação e boas práticas para desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Conhecimento em Processo Ágil, DevOps e plataformas Cloud (Azure).


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Protheus;
  • Conhecimento em PO-UI.

title: Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: Especialista em Microsoft Teams/Sharepoint
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Especialista em Microsoft Teams/Sharepoint

Estamos buscando um especialista microsoft SharePoint, com especialização em Microsoft Teams.


Descrição:


  • Experiência mandatória com Workshop, Piloto, Ativação, Otimização do Teams e dos Aplicativos;
  • Experiência em funções voltadas ao cliente em arquitetura de sistemas, administração, operações, suporte de software e consultoria de TI, com foco em Microsoft Teams;
  • Experiência com soluções técnicas para tratar problemas dos clientes, garantindo desempenho e confiabilidade ideais do Microsoft Teams;
  • Vivência avançada em engenharia e design arquitetural de Comunicações Unificadas, com foco em Microsoft Teams, configurações de PSTN, Teams Enterprise Voice, Direct Routing e infraestrutura de telefonia (como Session Border Controllers e Contact Centers);
  • Auxiliar na implantação, configuração e personalização do Microsoft Teams e de aplicativos relacionados para atender às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Conhecimento técnico profundo da arquitetura, recursos e funcionalidades do Microsoft Teams;
  • Experiência avançada com implantação do SharePoint, OneDrive e Exchange;
  • Experiência com administração do Microsoft Teams, incluindo gerenciamento de usuários, políticas e conformidade;
  • Soluções relacionadas, como SharePoint, OneDrive, Power Platform, Azure AD, Intune e outros serviços do M365;
  • Experiência no desenho e na implementação de soluções de Telefonia do Teams, incluindo Direct Routing, Calling Plans, Phone System e Voice Apps, além de Microsoft Teams Room Systems e configurações de hardware relacionadas;
  • Forte conhecimento de protocolos, padrões e melhores práticas de voz e rede;
  • Forte capacidade de solucionar problemas de chamadas, conferências e qualidade de chamada no Microsoft Teams;
  • Conhecimento e experiência na criação de bot no Teams, integração do Microsoft Graph em um aplicativo do Teams e conhecimento das ferramentas usadas para desenvolver aplicativos do Teams. Conhecimento do Microsoft Teams Toolkit é um diferencial;


Certificações:

  • Microsoft Certified: Teams Administrator Associate ou outras certificações relevantes;
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate;



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido - (Viagens exporaticas a nivel nacional)


O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

description:
AI-Augmented Software Engineer

Python | JavaScript | Cloud | AI Coding Agents

We are looking for a Software Engineer who builds software with AI as a core part of the development workflow.

This role is not for engineers who occasionally use Copilot . We are looking for developers who already work in an AI-augmented engineering environment , using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or other AI coding agents to significantly accelerate development.

title: Country Manager Assistant/Regional Assistant (Brazil)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Support the Brazil Country Manager in driving trading volume and user growth
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Product, UI, Marketing, Branding) to execute local initiatives effectively.
  • Act as the key liaison between HQ and local teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local partners and key stakeholders.
  • Track Brazil market trends and competitor activity to inform strategy.


Requirements


  • Based in Brazil long-term (São Paulo preferred), with 2–5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Background in Finance, Web3, Fintech, E-commerce, Technology, or International Chinese companies preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Chinese is an advantage.
  • Strong organizational skills with a proactive, results-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrates ambition, entrepreneurial spirit, and a strong commitment to career growth in Brazil.


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Business Analyst (BA)
description:
I am reaching out because we are in need of a new Business Analyst (BA) resource for our team, and I would like to request your support. Below are the details of the profile we are seeking:


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support initiatives related to our Core Banking systems. This professional will act as a key bridge between business and technology, ensuring clarity of requirements, alignment across teams, and effective delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Agile ceremonies, including:
  • Daily Scrum (when necessary)
  • Backlog Refinement
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Review
  • Sprint Retrospective (as observer or contributor)
  • Conduct requirements gathering and process analysis
  • Prepare and maintain the product backlog
  • Organize and manage dependencies across teams
  • Validate deliverables to ensure alignment with business needs
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
  • Leverage JIRA for tracking, documentation, and workflow management

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Experience with Core Banking systems, including:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Hands-on experience working in Agile teams
  • Strong knowledge of banking processes and system integration
  • Proven experience with:
  • Requirements gathering
  • Backlog preparation and refinement
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery validation
  • Proficiency with JIRA

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with JHA (Jack Henry & Associates) environment

title: Analista I de Desenvolvimento de Software | Ruby on Rails
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Ruby on Rails para integrar nosso time, focado em construir e manter soluções técnicas de alta qualidade. Se você gosta de trabalhar com metodologias ágeis e de criar aplicações escaláveis, essa oportunidade é para você.

Identificar não apenas o bug, mas sua causa raiz, propondo soluções eficazes para mitigar riscos.

  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção de aplicações utilizando o framework Ruby on Rails.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir APIs robustas, seguras e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a equipe na definição, desenho e implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Participar de ponta a ponta do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, atuando em um ambiente colaborativo e orientado por metodologias ágeis.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com desenvolvimento no framework Ruby on Rails.
  • Habilidade na construção, manutenção e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência com modelagem e uso de bancos de dados não relacionais (NoSQL).
  • Experiência em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Experiência específica com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento e prática em arquitetura REST.
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com arquitetura de Microsserviços.
  • Boa base em conceitos de arquitetura de software e vivência com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Analista de infraestrutura Junior - Linux
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Responsável por fornecer suporte técnico na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de servidores, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos sistemas e recursos de infraestrutura.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Instala servidores físicos ou virtuais, garantindo a configuração adequada dos sistemas operacionais e softwares relacionados;
  • Suporte de serviços de rede essenciais nos servidores, como DHCP, DNS, Controladores de Domínios, servidores de arquivos e impressão, para garantir a conectividade e a disponibilidade dos recursos de rede;
  • Realiza a manutenção regular dos servidores, aplicando atualizações de segurança, patches e correções de bugs para garantir a estabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas.
  • Presta suporte técnico aos usuários, solucionando problemas relacionados aos servidores, respondendo a solicitações de suporte e fornecendo orientações sobre o uso adequado dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Colabora em projetos de infraestrutura de servidores, auxiliando na implementação de novas tecnologias, migrações ou atualizações de servidores;
  • Mantém a documentação atualizada dos servidores, registrando configurações, alterações e procedimentos relevantes para referência futura e garantindo a consistência nas operações;
  • Mantém-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços tecnológicos relacionados à infraestrutura de servidores, buscando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos sistemas;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis, como reuniões de planejamento, retrospectivas e revisões, compartilhando informações sobre a infraestrutura de servidores e colaborando para a melhoria contínua do squad ágil.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada (desejável). ●

Conhecimentos:

  • Windows Server: Configuração e administração de servidores Windows, incluindo Active Directory, DHCP, DNS e funções de servidor.
  • Linux: Conhecimentos básicos de administração de sistemas Linux, gerenciamento de pacotes e comandos do shell.
  • Backup: Familiaridade com estratégias e ferramentas de backup, para garantir a proteção e recuperação de dados.
  • Redes: Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de redes, protocolos (TCP/IP) e configuração de dispositivos de rede.
  • Administração de servidores: Gerenciamento de servidores físicos e virtuais, incluindo instalação e configuração.
  • Virtualização: Conhecimento em tecnologias de virtualização como VMware ou Hyper-V.
  • Armazenamento: Noções sobre armazenamento de dados, RAID e tecnologias de armazenamento em rede (NAS e SAN).
  • Segurança da informação: Conhecimentos básicos de práticas de segurança cibernética e controle de acesso.
  • Monitoramento e resolução de problemas: Utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento para detectar e solucionar problemas de infraestrutura.
  • Automação e scripting: Habilidades básicas de automação usando scripts como PowerShell ou Shell Script.
  • Resolução de problemas: Capacidade de analisar e solucionar questões relacionadas à infraestrutura de TI.
  • Certificações relevantes em infraestrutura de servidores, como Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC), entre outras. (desejável)


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Customer Service Specialist Italian speaker
description:
We are looking for experienced Customer Service Representative Italian speaker


This is a full-time position.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent Italian verbal skills
  • English just for training purposes
  • At least 1 year of experience in phone customer service
  • Taking inbound calls


  • General Requirements Include:
  • Advanced computer proficiency utilizing windows based software
  • Ability to multi task
  • Strong verbal and written communications
  • Monday- Friday (full time)


Job description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Customer Service agents to join our team.

Key Responsibilities:


- Taking inbound calls to potential customers Service

- Build and maintain a strong customer database by accurately recording all customer information and interactions

- Provide excellent customer service and address any questions or concerns the customer may have

Benefits:

- Competitive salary paid in USA dollars

- Full-time, remote position

- Opportunity for growth and advancement within the company

- Training and support from experienced professionals

- Fun and dynamic work environment

Shift: Mon - Fri 9:00 am to 1:00 pm CET (Central Europe Time) with possibility to go full time


Technical Requirements:

1. Minimum 8GB RAM

2. Minimum 4th gen processor (i3 8GB RAM) (i5 4GB RAM) (i7 4GB RAM) / Ryzen 3000 series or newer

3. 10MB Download and 5MB Upload Speed

4. Must have USB Headsets

5. Must have a LAN Cable connection



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


The interview must be held from the location you will be working from and the equipment you will be using. If you pass the interview then our IT dept will need to do a PC Check. Your interview will be held through a video call so please wear business attire.

title: SAP MDK Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP MDK Consultant


Location: Remote

Experience: 4+ Years


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced SAP MDK Consultant with strong expertise in SAP Mobile Development Kit and SAP Asset Manager. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience developing and enhancing mobile applications, working with SAP BTP Mobile Services, and integrating with backend systems such as SAP S/4HANA.


Key Responsibilities


Develop, enhance, and maintain applications using SAP Mobile Development Kit.


Participate in SAP Asset Manager implementation projects, including full lifecycle delivery.


Enhance and extend standard functionality within SAP Asset Manager.


Create and debug MDK Branded Clients for Android and iOS platforms.


Configure and support the SAP Syclo Framework.


Perform troubleshooting using SAP Gateway tracing and error logs.


Develop and integrate applications using OData Services for mobile solutions.


Support upgrade activities related to SAP Asset Manager applications.


Ensure development follows architecture standards and best practices.


Manage and resolve MDK issues during Unit Testing and Integration Testing phases.


Maintain development SLAs and coordinate with cross-functional teams.


Required Skills


4+ years of experience in SAP Mobile Development Kit development.


Hands-on experience in SAP mobility solutions with at least one full lifecycle implementation in asset management mobility.


Experience deploying applications using SAP BTP Mobile Services.


Strong experience in SAP Asset Manager implementation and enhancements.


Expertise in OData services including online/offline synchronization.


Strong JavaScript skills for MDK rule development and customization.


Integration experience with SAP S/4HANA.


Knowledge of offline enablement, synchronization, security (OAuth/SAML), and performance optimization.


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of SAP ABAP debugging.


Experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) / Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) processes.


Exposure to legacy mobility platforms such as SAP Syclo.

title: Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator
description:
Training Coordinator/LMS Administrator

Start: April 1, 2026

Duration: 1 Year

Location: Remote from Brazil


Must speak English and Brazilian Portuguese


MUST APPLY WITH RESUME IN ENGLISH to be considered


Overview:

Provide administrative and project services, including direct location services to the client, data

entry in the Learning Management System, direct customer contact for training

administration and logistics, and support for other administrative tasks related to the assigned

contract.


Major Job Activities

Training Administration:

Schedule courses and trainers, send participant invitations, and confirm attendance.

Assist with the overall planning of training schedules.

Provide customer-facing support, including administration, training logistics, and event

management.

Book Venues and Trainers for all sessions

Register students online, complete certification claims, and handle exemptions.

Deal with customer enquiries and contact delegates prior to course attendance.

Manage online courses and classes.

Generate data reports using LMS.

Maintain accurate records and filing.

Coordinate with internal and external trainers/vendors.

Handle administration related to training content development, translation, proofreading,

and media production.

Cooperate during sales launch training.


Customer Support:

Provide direct customer contact for training administration and logistics.

Address customer enquiries and provide timely responses.

Perform data entry in the LMS.

Maintain and update training records.


Requirements:

Must have experience as an LMS Administrator in Workday, SuccessFactors OR Cornerstone on Demand

Must have experience as a coordinator - booking events and travel

Must have strong reporting skills

title: Consultor de Intercâmbio - Vendas
description:

Aqui na Egali sonhamos alto! Somos centenas de pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. A nossa cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde podemos ser a nossa melhor versão!

Sabemos que investir no potencial de nossos colaboradores é trazer ainda mais qualidade ao nosso negócio.

Nossa missão é promover o intercâmbio de forma responsável e por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos, com disposição para conectar pessoas aos seus sonhos.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em intercâmbio/Geolocalização.
  • Cursando Ensino superior nas áreas: Administração, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Comércio Exterior, Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Comercial e áreas correlatadas;
  • Excelente relacionamento, escuta ativa e empática, comunicação assertiva, excelente redação e muita energia para colocar a mão na massa;
  • Organização e gestão do tempo também são habilidades fundamentais para esta posição;
  • Interesse e/ou experiencia com área comercial


Quais são as atividades?

  • Atender clientes via telefone, e-mail ou pessoalmente no escritório da empresa;

  • Prospectar novos leads.
  • Atendimento personalizado e consultivo.


Vamos explorar o mundo juntos!

Na Egali, somos apaixonados por gente. Por isso, todas as nossas posições são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, de gêneros e orientação sexual diversas, incluindo todas as etnias e religiões. Estamos focados em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde podemos ser sempre a nossa melhor versão!


A Egali Trail – Um plano individual de carreira em que você se desenvolve para Egali e para o mercado


Benefícios que Valorizam seu Trabalho:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado + comissão.

  • Alimentação:

  • Licença Maternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para você e seu bebê nos primeiros meses.

title: AI Developer/ 100% Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Profile: AI Developer – Integrations & Automation

Job Type: Long-time based Contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil


Job Description:


Role Summary

The AI Engineer – Integrations & Automation will design, build, and maintain AI‑driven automations and integrations that reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of AI platforms, internal systems, and business workflows. This is a remote position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Automation of complex workflows: Design, build, and maintain automated processes leveraging tools such as Zapier, Glean , or custom Python-based automation frameworks .
  • Systems integration: Develop, implement, and document internal APIs to connect AI services with existing enterprise applications (e.g., Google Workspace, Salesforce, internal SaaS platforms ).
  • Agentic infrastructure: Integrate platforms such as Glean, OpenAI, and Perplexity into operational pipelines to enable multi‑agent orchestration and intelligent decisioning.
  • Cross-functional delivery: Partner with Finance, HR, Editorial, Events , and other teams to translate operational needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Scalable solutions: Propose and implement integration architectures that reduce manual workflows, increase efficiency, and ensure long‑term reliability.
  • Documentation & knowledge transfer: Maintain detailed technical documentation of workflows, decision logic, and system connections for internal knowledge sharing.
  • Future-proofing: Evaluate emerging AI and LLM tooling to identify opportunities for continuous improvement of enterprise operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience with Python and at least one automation / integration platform (e.g., Zapier, n8n, custom orchestration frameworks).
  • Proven background building APIs, integrations, or backend services that connect multiple SaaS systems.
  • Hands-on exposure to LLM / AI platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication , and event-driven architectures.
  • Ability to work directly with non‑technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver usable solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Glean (search, knowledge, and/or agentic workflows).
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace and Google Cloud tools (e.g., BigQuery , Vertex AI, or similar).
  • Experience with Claude or other state-of-the-art LLMs.
  • Experience in enterprise environments (identity, security, compliance).
  • Prior work with multi‑agent systems , RAG pipelines, or observability for AI workflows

title: Analista de banco de dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, permitindo que nossos clientes foquem em seus principais negócios enquanto cuidamos de suas necessidades de TI.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Analista de Banco de Dados – Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex (alimentação e refeição)
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações com premiação
  • Licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de 20 dias
  • Acesso às plataformas de aprendizado (NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy – +80 mil cursos)
  • GetVibes: programa de escuta ativa com foco em melhoria contínua


O que esperar desta posição:

Você atuará na construção, sustentação e evolução de pipelines de dados e soluções analíticas, garantindo qualidade, governança e disponibilidade das informações para suportar decisões estratégicas do negócio.

Será responsável por integrar diferentes fontes de dados, estruturar ambientes analíticos e apoiar na criação de dashboards e monitoramento de métricas, trabalhando em conjunto com times multidisciplinares em um ambiente ágil.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com bancos de dados:
  • DB2, Redis, Oracle e NoSQL
  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração de dados como IBM DataStage
  • Vivência com ambientes de dados em nuvem, especialmente Azure Databricks
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados:
  • Power BI e/ou Tibco Spotfire
  • Domínio de Python (versão 3.12+)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e analytics como Matomo
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade com OpenTelemetry
  • Familiaridade com Microsoft Copilot
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum)


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com arquitetura de dados em larga escala
  • Conhecimento em governança e qualidade de dados
  • Vivência com integração de múltiplos sistemas e fontes
  • Experiência com automação de pipelines e boas práticas de engenharia de dados

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.


Responsibilities:

1. Maintain relationships with merchants and users on the platform.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

title: Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior – Automation Anywhere
description:
A Practia está presente em 9 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor RPA Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico, integrando um time de analistas, arquitetos e desenvolvedores.

Essa pessoa atuará de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a revisão da documentação funcional, avaliação de complexidade, suporte ao design e arquitetura da solução, desenvolvimento das automações, sustentação, monitoramento, implantação em produção e apoio ao período de hypercare.

Além disso, será treinada em nosso framework proprietário e metodologia de Hyperautomação SmartBPA®, que cobre toda a jornada — do Discovery à implementação do COE.

Como parte da equipe de Intelligent Automation, você colaborará com times multidisciplinares para entregar automações robustas, seguras, escaláveis e de alta qualidade.

O que buscamos

  • Profissional sênior, com forte experiência em desenvolvimento e sustentação de automações.
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e com visão de qualidade e governança.
  • Alguém que gosta de atuar em ambientes que valorizam competência, transparência e confiança.
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente iniciativas, apoiar decisões de arquitetura e orientar membros do time.

Responsabilidades

  • Revisar documentação funcional, apoiar estimativas e propor melhorias.
  • Desenvolver, implantar, monitorar e sustentar automações no Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Construir e manter componentes reutilizáveis, boas práticas e padrões internos.
  • Integrar automações com APIs, bancos de dados, serviços corporativos e soluções de GenAI/ML e IDP.
  • Atuar em projetos de migração de versões, refactoring ou atualizações de arquitetura A360.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução garantindo performance, segurança e compliance.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento do framework e processos internos de automação.
  • Realizar troubleshooting, análise raiz de incidentes e melhorias de estabilidade.
  • Apoiar testes integrados, homologação e hypercare de novas entregas.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Sistemas ou Administração.
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática com Automation Anywhere (preferencialmente).
  • Certificações Automation Anywhere Advanced e Master. (Obrigatório)

Experiência sólida em:

  • Sustentação e monitoramento de automações (Fila, Control Room, logs, dashboards).
  • Integração via APIs, bancos de dados e aplicações corporativas.
  • Desenvolvimento e depuração de workflows complexos.
  • Implementação de tratativas robustas de erro e resiliência.
  • Documentação PDD e SDD.
  • Uso de frameworks e boas práticas.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente pequenos times ou células de sustentação.

Conhecimentos Diferenciais

  • Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Domínio de produtos adicionais Automation Anywhere:
  • IA Agents
  • IA Studio
  • Document Automation
  • Enterprise Knowledge
  • Conhecimento em Python, VBScript ou JavaScript.
  • Experiência com GenAI, Machine Learning e IDP integrado a processos automatizados.
  • Outras certificações na área de automação inteligente, RPA, IA ou arquitetura.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Kotlin SR | Aceitação PJ
description:
Conheça melhor a unidade de negócio que essa vaga pertence:


A BU de Banking é especializada em oferecer soluções financeiras customizadas. Combinando expertise financeira com tecnologia avançada, visa facilitar operações diárias, otimizar a gestão financeira e apoiar o crescimento sustentável das empresas, garantindo sempre uma experiência segura, eficiente e personalizada.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com experiência em Kotlin para integrar nosso time. Procuramos alguém com paixão por tecnologia, vontade de aprender e colaborar para construir soluções inovadoras que gerem impacto no negócio e na experiência de nossos clientes.


Responsabilidade e atribuições:


  • Tenha paixão por tecnologia e se mantenha atualizado(a) sobre as novidades do setor;
  • Goste de aprender e trabalhar com diferentes tecnologias e linguagens;
  • Participe ativamente das rotinas do time, propondo e discutindo soluções que atendam aos objetivos do negócio;
  • Tenha um olhar crítico e senso de dono sobre o que criamos no dia a dia;
  • Acompanhe e utilize métricas e indicadores do time para identificar e propor melhorias, sustentabilidade e novas oportunidades;
  • Colabore na criação e evolução dos fluxos de trabalho do time, garantindo eficácia e eficiência;
  • Desenvolva, coloque em produção, monitore e mantenha a saúde dos softwares e serviços entregues;
  • Melhore continuamente as bases de código, equilibrando velocidade de entrega e qualidade;
  • Realize e aceite feedbacks como parte de um ambiente colaborativo e voltado ao crescimento;
  • Assuma o protagonismo do seu autodesenvolvimento e da evolução da sua carreira profissional.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Programação orientada a objetos;
  • Experiência com Java (21 ou 24)
  • Experiência com Kotlin;
  • Frameworks como Spring Boot, Spring Data, e uso de JPA;
  • Design de APIs REST;
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em princípios como SOLID, Clean Code e padrões de projeto;
  • Experiência com CI/CD e ferramentas de automação;
  • Testes unitários e de integração;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e conteinerização;
  • Familiaridade com mensageria (ex.: Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS);
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com controle de versão usando Git;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em sistemas distribuídos (OAuth, JWT, etc.);
  • Experiência em processos de Code Review para garantir qualidade e boas práticas.


O que oferecemos:

Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • Wellhub.

Alimentação/ Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho:

  • Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios, com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).

Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:

  • Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
  • Programa \"Novo Ser\", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Falando nisso, ao retornar da licença maternidade, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada.

Reconhecemos resultados: PPR- Participação nos Resultados do PicPay.

title: OpenClaw Trajectory Specialist - 65130
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly analytical professionals to join as S3 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating advanced OpenClaw trajectories for research-oriented tasks involving ambiguous goals, multi-step reasoning, and long-context workflows.


This role requires strong problem-solving ability, research thinking, and the capability to justify decisions while executing complex, multi-tool workflows used to train sophisticated AI agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and validate OpenClaw trajectories for complex, research-oriented tasks
  • Work on tasks such as data analysis, web research, and document synthesis
  • Operate under underspecified or ambiguous goals , making logical and defensible decisions
  • Use Python (notebooks, scripts) for data processing, automation, and analysis
  • Perform workflows spanning multiple tools, environments, and applications
  • Clearly document both what actions were taken and why they were taken
  • Review and improve trajectory quality for reasoning depth and correctness
  • Collaborate with teams to refine evaluation standards and annotation frameworks


Requirements:

  • Background in research, data science, engineering, or related fields (academic or industry)
  • 5+ years of experience in Python / Bash , including experience with notebooks and data wrangling
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar advanced environments
  • Experience with web research, scraping tools, or data analysis workflows
  • Ability to articulate reasoning behind decisions and steps
  • Experience handling multi-step workflows across tools or platforms
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows


Nice to Have:

  • Academic research experience (thesis, publications, lab work )
  • Familiarity with evaluation methodologies or experimental design
  • Experience in AI evaluation, RLHF, or advanced annotation workflows


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

    • Flexible hours

    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Customer Service Technical Support
description:
Company Description

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Our dedicated consultants collaborate with top companies globally, offering industry insights while mentoring and training candidates. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. At Kyniska, we are committed to enabling professional growth and creating impactful employment connections.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Customer Service Technical Support professional. Responsibilities include delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and enhancing customer experience through proficient problem-solving and communication. The individual will handle customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat, troubleshoot technical issues, and work diligently to resolve customer concerns while maintaining professional and empathetic interaction.

Qualifications
  • Strong skills in Customer Service and Customer Support, ensuring the ability to manage and resolve client inquiries efficiently.
  • Expertise in Customer Satisfaction and Customer Experience, with a focus on delivering solutions to improve customer relationships.
  • Proficiency in Phone Etiquette and effective communication skills, providing a professional and empathetic approach to customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while being a collaborative team player.
  • Problem-solving aptitude and a keen attention to detail, especially in handling technical customer issues.
  • A background in IT, technical support, or related fields is a valuable asset.
  • Experience using CRM or help desk software is a plus.

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.


What you can expect from a career with our team!

  • Overall compensation = INR 272.13 = USD $3.00 per hour based on experience
  • Schedule: 8 hours per day between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST
  • Commitment: Full-time, 40+ hours per week
  • Work Setup: Fully remote position


You will have opportunities to learn new skills from our team of experienced professionals.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level and gain valuable experience, apply today!

title: Key Account Manager - Foco em Redes de Recarga
description:
Venha fazer parte da maior fabricante de medidores elétricos da América Latina!

Somos uma empresa de 95 anos que atua como provedora de tecnologia e soluções completas para o segmento de energia elétrica.

#VemSerNansen


Suas atividades serão:

  • Gestão de Relacionamento: Construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes estratégicos, atuando como ponto de contato principal.
  • Desenvolvimento de Negócios: Identificar oportunidades de crescimento dentro das contas existentes e propor soluções que agreguem valor.
  • Negociação e Contratos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, monitorar elaboração de propostas e monitorar processos de operações e pós-vendas.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Acompanhar indicadores de vendas
  • Integração Interna: Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de operações, marketing, pós vendas e financeiro para assegurar a execução eficiente das estratégias.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Mapear tendências, concorrência e oportunidades no setor de distribuição e recarga.


Esta vaga é afirmativa e extensiva a toda a diversidade de pessoas, seja pela sua cor, etnia, gênero, religião, deficiência, faixa etária ou orientação sexual.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Vivência em setores de distribuição
  • Experiência em gestão de indicadores de performance (KPIs) e relatórios estratégicos.
  • Participação em projetos de expansão de canais de distribuição ou integração de soluções de recarga.
  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Energia, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado / fluente.


Confira nossos benefícios:

️ Vale-refeição (VR)

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.


What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.


Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.


We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.


This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.


More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships


What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.


Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.


Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.


If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!
